column2: a speaker's rostrum (a parliamentary lectern) seen from the front: a tall box-shaped desk with a sloped reading top, a stepped Art Deco base of three widening steps, and two or three vertical fluting slits cut into its front panel

a fedora hat, the brimmed felt hat of the 1925 Turkish hat reform, seen from the front on its own: a crown with a clear centre crease (pinch) on top and a dent at each front side, a wide brim curving slightly up at both ends, and one bold hatband cut out as a single straight white bar around the base of the crown. No head, no face, no feather. Must clearly read as a fedora, not a bowler, top hat or cowboy hat

a round pleated ribbon cockade seen from the front: a wide circle of radiating pleats with a scalloped outer edge, a thin white ring cut between the pleats and a plain solid round centre button; two short ribbon tails hanging below with V-notched ends. No cross, no plus sign, no star, no cut in the centre button
a fountain pen nib, upright with the point down: a pointed shield shape with a centre slit running from the point to a small round breather hole, and a straight shoulder at the top
a pair of military field binoculars seen from the front: two thick upright barrels joined by a central hinge, with the two round eyepieces at the top cut out as rings
the citadel of Ankara on its hill: a crenellated fortress wall with three square towers of different heights, standing on a solid stepped rocky hill; two small window slits in the tallest tower
a leather document briefcase seen from the front: a wide rectangle with rounded lower corners, a carrying handle on top, a flap across the upper third with a small rectangular clasp cut out
three sheets of paper (bills) stacked and fanned slightly, the front sheet with two bold horizontal text bars cut out and a small round stamp
a speaker's hand bell standing upright: a bell-shaped body with a flared rim and a turned wooden handle on top; one bold band cut around the bell

a pair of heavy stage curtains drawn shut and caught in the middle by one tie-back, so the two panels pinch in at the centre and flare out at top and bottom into an hourglass silhouette; a straight curtain rail across the top; two or three long curved fold slits in each panel. Must not look like a column, a box or a building
an aide-de-camp's aiguillette: a braided cord hanging in two loops from a short shoulder bar, the two cord ends finishing in two pointed metal tips side by side at the bottom
a ballot box seen from the front: a box with a slot in its lid and a folded voting paper half-way inserted into the slot, standing up out of it

a tear-off wall calendar block: a tall rectangle with a binding strip across the top and a hanging ring above it, the top sheet blank except for one thick horizontal bar near its top; a torn corner at the lower right
a lit torch held upright: a fluted Art Deco handle tapering down, a cup at the top, and a tall flame of three bold pointed tongues rising from it
a rising sun behind a stepped Art Deco skyline: three square buildings of different heights across the bottom, a half sun rising behind them with seven straight sharp rays
two bold chevrons pointing to the right, one behind the other, like a road sign for forward; thick and geometric
a firm handshake: two hands clasped, seen from the side, the two forearms entering from left and right, simplified into bold geometric shapes; a cuff on each wrist

the Çankaya mansion: a two-storey stone house with a hipped roof, a small square tower with its own roof rising at one side, a row of tall windows cut out on each floor, and a short flight of steps to the door

a parliamentary bill: a single upright sheet of paper with a folded top-right corner, four bold horizontal text bars cut out across it, and a round official stamp cut as a ring with a solid centre near its lower right
an Art Deco staircase of five steps rising from left to right, seen from the side, with a small solid five-pointed star above the top step
a medal hanging from a short ribbon: a vertical ribbon with two parallel slits, a short bar, and a round medal below it with a five-pointed star cut out of its centre
a coin standing upright, seen from the front, split down the middle: the left half a solid half disc, the right half a thick half ring with a hollow centre, a narrow gap between the halves
a closed padlock: a thick rounded shackle on top of a rectangular body with chamfered corners, a keyhole cut out of the body
a round wall clock whose hands point backwards: a thick round rim, two clock hands, and one bold curved arrow running anticlockwise around the inside of the rim
a dark lantern, the kind carried at night by conspirators: a cylindrical body with a hinged shutter half closed over its lens, a carrying ring on top, and a narrow beam slit
two bold chevrons pointing to the left, one behind the other, like a road sign for backward; thick and geometric

a folded newspaper lying flat, turned about 12 degrees clockwise: the front page shows a broad solid headline band across the top, a square photo block cut out at the left, and three thick horizontal text lines cut out beside and below it; the lower right corner folded over. No vertical columns. Must not look like a box or a building
one raised open hand, palm forward, fingers together and thumb out, the forearm and a shirt cuff below it, simplified into bold geometric shapes
a featureless bust (head and shoulders) seen in profile facing right, standing on a stepped Art Deco plinth of two steps; no facial features, just the silhouette
a magnifying glass: a thick round rim with a hollow lens, the handle running down to the lower right
a ballot box knocked over on its side on a short floor line, its lid fallen open and three voting slips spilling out onto the floor
a closed envelope seen from the front: a wide rectangle with the triangular flap at the top cut out as a V-shaped slit, and a small round wax seal at the flap's point
an old key, upright with the bit at the bottom: a round bow at the top with a hole cut out, a straight shank, and a stepped bit
